dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts members of the Crow Tribe of Montana, local water system operations, and federal agencies.
dimensions.evidence: revises the water rights settlement agreement entered into by the Crow Tribe of Montana and Montana

dimensions.assessment: Modifies financial fund structures, project terms, and hydropower construction rights for the reservation.
dimensions.evidence: create a new MR&I Projects Account, through which the tribe must use funds for activities related to water production, treatment, or delivery infrastructure

dimensions.assessment: Reallocates and manages settlement funds and accounts while stating the federal government has no obligation for certain operational costs.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal Government shall have no obligation to pay for the operation, maintenance, or replacement of any MR&I Project.

dimensions.assessment: Amends previous settlement legislation by repealing specific sections, establishing new accounts, and adjusting timelines.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Act of 2010 to make improvements to that Act, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Extends hydropower construction rights to 20 years and establishes permanent administrative and ownership structures for water projects.
dimensions.evidence: Title to, control over, and operation of any project constructed using funds from the MR&I Projects Account shall remain in the Tribe.

missing_information: Total dollar amounts deposited or to be appropriated into the newly created MR&I Projects Account
importance_detail.rationale: The bill revises the Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Act of 2010 by restructuring accounts, extending construction deadlines, and clarifying infrastructure ownership and funding rules.
